name: ew-nomoreleaks-edgekv
description: EdgeWorker that checks username/password hashes against a leaked-credential list in EdgeKV

config.description: EdgeWorker that checks username/password hashes against a leaked-credential list in EdgeKV

scripts.build-ts: tsc && npm run package:vendor && npm run build-bundle-json
scripts.package:vendor: test -f vendor/edgekv_tokens.js || (echo 'ERROR: vendor/edgekv_tokens.js is missing - see vendor/edgekv_tokens.js.template or run npm run generate-edgekv-token' && exit 1) && cp vendor/edgekv.js vendor/edgekv_tokens.js built/
scripts.build-ew-tgz: mkdir -p dist && cd built && tar czvf ../dist/ew_${EWID:-$npm_package_config_ewid}_$npm_package_version.tgz *
scripts.package: npm run build-ts && npm run build-ew-tgz
scripts.activate-edgeworker: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:-$npm_package_config_edgerc_section}"); [ -n "${AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY:-$npm_package_config_accountswitchkey}" ] && args+=(--accountkey "${AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY:-$npm_package_config_accountswitchkey}"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" activate "${EWID:-$npm_package_config_ewid}" staging $npm_package_version'
scripts.activate-edgeworker-prod: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:-$npm_package_config_edgerc_section}"); [ -n "${AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY:-$npm_package_config_accountswitchkey}" ] && args+=(--accountkey "${AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY:-$npm_package_config_accountswitchkey}"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" activate "${EWID:-$npm_package_config_ewid}" production $npm_package_version'
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run lint && npm run package && npm run upload-edgeworker && npm run activate-edgeworker
scripts.create-edgekv-ns: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:-$npm_package_config_edgerc_section}"); [ -n "${AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY:-$npm_package_config_accountswitchkey}" ] && args+=(--accountkey "${AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY:-$npm_package_config_accountswitchkey}"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" create ns staging "$npm_package_config_edgekv_namespace" --retention 0 --groupId "${EW_GROUP_ID:-$npm_package_config_ew_group_id}"'
scripts.generate-edgekv-token: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:-$npm_package_config_edgerc_section}"); [ -n "${AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY:-$npm_package_config_accountswitchkey}" ] && args+=(--accountkey "${AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY:-$npm_package_config_accountswitchkey}"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" create token nml-ro --save_path=./vendor --staging=allow --production=allow --ewids="${EWID:-$npm_package_config_ewid}" --namespace=namespace-"$npm_package_config_edgekv_namespace"+r --expiry="$EXPIRY"'

author: jgrinwis@akamai.com
